item.title: Two lamp posts are not working., 18th October
item.description:
Two lamp posts are out at the bottom of the ramp way coming down from over the railway. It is very dark, and it can be a serious trip hazard when you come down from the ramp and there is the kerb/step down to the road. The lights have been out for more than two weeks. Please can this be investigated and the lights fixed as urgent as possible. Thank you.

item.title: Double yellow lines have faded/Cars parking too close to end of Kynaston Road/, 17th October
item.description:
The double yellow lines that used to be here have faded completely, this means that cars are being parked too close to the end of the junction which makes it very difficult when a car is turning into the road and another is trying to come out. It means that cars have to be on the wrong side of the road to get to the give way line which will eventually lead to a collision when a car is coming around the corner.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Kynaston Road, Sundridge, Greater London
